name: jamboree
title: Jamboree
description: A scout-group theme on khaki drill: the masthead wears the group neckerchief, the name on a white name tape with two teal rolled bands dropping to a leather slide ring, and the week, programme and leaders sit on topstitched white tapes.

tokens.--font-display: heavy grotesque capitals: name, menu, headings, dates, labels
tokens.--font-body: body text, event and news titles, times, places, roles
tokens.--tracking-caps: letter spacing of the small capitals
tokens.--color-bg: khaki drill ground (olive drab at night); join link lettering
tokens.--color-text: ink on the ground: menu, headlines, intro, footer; join link fill
tokens.--color-muted: quieter ink on the ground: founded line, block headings, kickers
tokens.--color-accent: mark of the current menu entry, link underlines, inner focus ring
tokens.--color-seam: fold line of the seams under the masthead and above the footer
tokens.--color-thread: stitches of those seams; menu mark under the pointer
tokens.--color-tape: white tape panels: page text, programme, news, people, regular week, facts, tags
tokens.--color-tape-ink: text on a tape; members-only label, cancelled label edge, table head rules
tokens.--color-tape-muted: secondary text on a tape: times, places, descriptions, roles, past dates
tokens.--color-stitch: topstitching inside tapes, stitched lines between rows and cells
tokens.--color-nametape: the name tape in the masthead; lettering of the open-to-all label
tokens.--color-nametape-ink: the site's name on the name tape
tokens.--color-kerchief: the neckerchief cloth; regular-week edge, open-to-all label, quote rule
tokens.--color-kerchief-border: the gold border: stripes on the bands, tail edges, regular-week edge, open-to-all rim
tokens.--color-roll-shade: shadow rounding the bands, tails and ring; the ring's braid
tokens.--color-roll-sheen: highlight on the bands and the slide ring
tokens.--color-code-bg: background of code in page text
tokens.--color-focus: outer ring of the focus outline
tokens.--shadow-tape: soft edge under the name tape and a cover image
tokens.--radius: corner rounding of tapes, labels, the join link, images
tokens.--stitch: inset of the topstitching from a tape's edge
tokens.--vee-width: gap between the bands at the name tape; V, ring and tails follow from it
tokens.--vee-angle: angle of each rolled band from the upright
tokens.--band: thickness of a rolled band; ring and tails are sized from it
tokens.--space-3: page gutter on phones, gap under headings
tokens.--space-5: gap at the foot of the page
